scenario: The ego vehicle rear-ends a white car that suddenly brakes on a multi-lane highway due to a lane bottleneck.

ego.behavior: The car travels forward on the highway and emergency brakes but collides with the vehicle ahead.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels forward ahead of the ego vehicle and suddenly brakes hard to avoid congestion, causing a rear-end collision.
The truck travels forward in the right adjacent lane, contributing to the lane bottleneck.
The silver van changes from the right lane to the left lane ahead of the ego vehicle, merging into the congested traffic flow.
The white car travels forward in the right lane, moving ahead of the ego vehicle as traffic disperses.
The dark-colored SUV travels forward in the right lane, moving ahead as the bottleneck clears.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is in the left lane of a multi-lane highway, following a white car directly ahead, with a large tanker truck in the right adjacent lane and multiple other vehicles merging and moving in both lanes ahead.
requirements_and_restrictions: Initial distance is defined between the ego vehicle and the white car ahead; the scenario terminates upon collision with the white car.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned overhead on the highway, visible ahead of the ego vehicle, displaying directional and distance information.
